In the Platinum Wealth Plan, the predeﬁned allocation is 80 per cent to its growth fund and 20 per cent to a secure fund when 16-20 years remain.

Balance sheet & cash: If the policyholder opts for such a strategy, the insurer automatic- ally switches between equity and debt funds according to a predetermined formula.

HDFC Life, too, oﬀers an Automatic Asset Rebalancing Strategy in its Smart Pension Plan, where allocations between equity-oriented funds and a debt-oriented fund change ac- cording to the number of years remaining to vesting.
A policyholder need not remem- ber to shift money from equity to debt every few years or decide how much to move.
Risks & challenges: It declines further to 55 per cent at 46-55, 45 per cent at ages 56- 65, and ﬁnally 35 per cent for ages 66 and above.
